dict.string: Flow Like uses your location when you request it in a workflow or map, or choose to share it with a bot.
Flow Like uses your location when you request it in a workflow or map, or choose to share it with a bot.
Flow Like monitors the regions you enable so location Events can run when you arrive or leave, including while the app is closed.
Flow Like uses the camera when you turn it on in a call, take a photo, scan a document, or start a video workflow.
Flow Like records your voice when you start dictation, a voice chat, or an audio workflow.
Flow Like turns your speech into an editable message when you choose to dictate to a bot.
Flow Like automates and integrates with other apps you choose (e.g., Finder) to manage files.
Flow Like needs Accessibility access to automate mouse clicks, keyboard input, and read UI elements in your workflows.
Flow Like captures your screen when you choose to share it in a call or use screenshots in an automation workflow.
